profile.headline: Senior Software Developer
profile.summary:
•	30+ years in software engineering with broad expertise across design, programming, process development, and lifecycle management.
•	Proven record delivering database solutions for government, defense, banking, manufacturing, healthcare, and public safety sectors.
•	Leadership in international projects, application globalization, and cross-functional team direction.
•	Clear, influential communication; strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
•	Database skills: Sybase, Oracle, SQL Server, IBM DB2, MySQL, and others.
•	Programming: C#, .NET, ASPX, C, C++, SQL/PLSQL, Fortran, Pascal, PowerBuilder, Visual Studio (including Visual Basic), IBM CSet, Delphi Builder, J Builder, Java, JavaScript, XML/XSL, HTML.
•	DevOps/Cloud: Azure, Docker, Git/GitLab, CI/CD pipeline setup, secure code practices.
•	Certifications: Security+.
•	Active Top Secret Clearance.
